name: DoubleTick
description: DoubleTick WhatsApp Business inbox: connected WhatsApp numbers, chats and message history, customers with tags and custom fields, templates, broadcast groups, team, notes, quick replies and wallet balance, plus sending text, media and template messages.
instructions:
## DoubleTick
This connector talks to the DoubleTick public API at `https://public.doubletick.io`. DoubleTick is a shared WhatsApp Business (WABA) inbox used mostly in India: several agents answer customers from one or more WhatsApp business numbers.

## Setup
In the DoubleTick web app (web.doubletick.io) open **Settings → Developer Documentation** and click **Create new key**. Put the key in `DOUBLETICK_API_KEY`. It is sent as-is in the `Authorization` header, without `Bearer`.

**The key acts as the user who created it.** It sees the WhatsApp numbers, chats and templates assigned to that user. If `doubletick_list_channels` returns an empty `channels` list, no WhatsApp number is assigned to that user. Chats may still be listed, but `all_waba_phone_numbers=true` then finds no templates: pass the number explicitly in `waba_phone_numbers`, or have an admin assign the number to the user.

## Start here
1. `doubletick_list_channels`: the connected WhatsApp numbers (`wabaNumber`). Almost every other call needs one of them.
2. `doubletick_list_chats` for the inbox, then `doubletick_get_chat_messages` with the WABA number and the customer number for a conversation.
3. `doubletick_get_customer` for a contact's name, tags, custom fields and assigned agent.

## Phone numbers
Always with country code. DoubleTick accepts `+919876543210` or `919876543210` on most endpoints; query parameters are safest as digits only (`919876543210`). Group ids look like `grp_...` (WhatsApp groups) or `group_...` (broadcast groups).

## Templates and the 24-hour window
WhatsApp only allows free-form messages (`doubletick_send_text_message`, image, document) within 24 hours of the customer's last message. Check with `doubletick_get_chat_window_status`. Outside the window send an approved template with `doubletick_send_template_message`. `doubletick_list_templates` needs `waba_phone_numbers` (comma-separated, digits only) or `all_waba_phone_numbers=true`.

## Errors
DoubleTick uses **422 for 'nothing found' and business-rule refusals** (no templates for this filter, roles not found, agent not in the team), not only for invalid input. A 422 on `doubletick_list_templates` means no template matched: the numbers asked for are not assigned to the key's user, or the filters exclude everything. Pass `waba_phone_numbers` explicitly, use `status=ALL` and no language filter. `doubletick_get_customer` answers 404 for an unknown number; `doubletick_get_customer` and `doubletick_list_notes` answer 400 when called without a phone number (or group id for notes).

## Pagination and limits
Chats use a cursor: pass `paginationOptions.nextChatId` and `nextChatTimestamp` from the previous answer. Broadcast groups page with `after_group_id` / `after_group_name` / `after_date_created`; notes with `last_note_id` / `last_note_date`. Rate limits are per organisation: chat messages 300 per minute, customer details 180 per minute, notes 60 per minute, message status 1 per second.

## Sending
Sending costs WhatsApp conversation fees from the DoubleTick wallet (`doubletick_get_wallet_balance`). The send tools return a `messageId`; follow delivery with `doubletick_get_message_status`.

DOUBLETICK_API_KEY.label: API key
DOUBLETICK_API_KEY.help: DoubleTick web app → Settings → Developer Documentation → Create new key. The key acts as your user, so create it with an account that has the WhatsApp numbers you want to use.

verifyHints.401: DoubleTick refused the key ('Invalid public api key'). Create a new one under Settings → Developer Documentation and paste it without 'Bearer'.
verifyHints.422: DoubleTick found nothing for this request. Check that the key's user has a WhatsApp number assigned (doubletick_list_channels).

tools.name: doubletick_list_channels
tools.description: List the WhatsApp business numbers (WABA channels) assigned to the key's user, with number, display name and profile. Call this first: most other tools need one of these numbers. Empty means the user has no number assigned.

tools.name: doubletick_list_chats
tools.description: List inbox chats, most recent first, with customer, last message, status, tags and assigned agent. Filter by status, tags, agent or WhatsApp number. Cursor paging: up to 100 per call.

assigned_user_phone.description: Phone number of the assigned agent; the text null for unassigned chats.

waba_numbers.description: Comma-separated WhatsApp business numbers (WhatsApp chats only).

next_chat_id.description: Cursor: paginationOptions.nextChatId from the previous answer.

next_chat_timestamp.description: Cursor: paginationOptions.nextChatTimestamp from the previous answer (epoch ms).

tools.name: doubletick_get_chat_messages
tools.description: Get the messages exchanged between one of your WhatsApp numbers and a customer, optionally between two dates. Use it to read a conversation before replying or to summarise it.

waba_number.description: Your WhatsApp business number, digits with country code, from doubletick_list_channels.

customer_number.description: Customer phone number with country code, digits only.

tools.name: doubletick_get_chat_window_status
tools.description: Check whether the 24-hour WhatsApp customer service window with a customer is open, which decides if a free-form message can be sent or a template is required.

waba_number.description: Your WhatsApp business number with country code.

customer_phone_number.description: Customer phone number with country code.

tools.name: doubletick_get_customer
tools.description: Get a customer by phone number or customer id (one of the two is needed): name, assigned agent, opt-in, custom fields and, when a WhatsApp number is given, the tags for that number. 404 when unknown.

phone_number.description: Customer phone number with country code.

customer_id.description: DoubleTick customer id, instead of the phone number.

waba_number.description: Your WhatsApp business number, to include the customer's tags for it.

tools.name: doubletick_list_templates
tools.description: List WhatsApp message templates with name, language, category, components (header, body with placeholders, footer, buttons) and approval status. Pass waba_phone_numbers, or all_waba_phone_numbers=true for the numbers assigned to the key's user.

waba_phone_numbers.description: Comma-separated WhatsApp business numbers, digits with country code, e.g. 919999999999.

all_waba_phone_numbers.description: true for the templates of every number the user can access, instead of waba_phone_numbers.

status.description: Approval status. Use ALL to see every template.

language.description: Template language code, e.g. en, en_US, hi. Leave empty for all languages.

tools.name: doubletick_list_broadcast_groups
tools.description: List broadcast groups (contact lists for template broadcasts) with id, name, member count and creation date. Search by name and page with the after_* cursors.

after_group_id.description: Cursor: id of the last group of the previous page.

after_group_name.description: Cursor: name of the last group (when sorting by name).

after_date_created.description: Cursor: creation date of the last group (when sorting by date).

tools.name: doubletick_list_team
tools.description: List the team members of the organisation with name, phone number, role and reporting managers. Agent phone numbers are used to assign chats.

tools.name: doubletick_get_team_member
tools.description: Get one team member by phone number: role, reporting managers, channel access and organisation details.

agent_number.description: Team member phone number with country code.

tools.name: doubletick_get_wallet_balance
tools.description: Get the organisation's DoubleTick wallet balance, from which WhatsApp conversation fees are paid. Check it before large template sends or broadcasts.

tools.name: doubletick_get_message_status
tools.description: Get the delivery status of a sent message (sent, delivered, read, failed) from the messageId returned by a send tool. Limited to one call per second per organisation.

message_id.description: messageId returned when the message was sent.

tools.name: doubletick_list_notes
tools.description: List internal notes on a customer chat (from + to) or a WhatsApp group chat (group_id), newest first, with author and mentions. Notes are visible to the team only.

from.description: Your WhatsApp business number with country code. With to, for a customer chat.

to.description: Customer phone number with country code.

group_id.description: WhatsApp group id, instead of from and to.

limit.description: Notes to return, up to 100. Default 30.

last_note_id.description: Cursor: id of the last note of the previous page.

last_note_date.description: Cursor: date of the last note of the previous page.

tools.name: doubletick_list_quick_replies
tools.description: List the saved quick replies (canned answers) with shortcut and text. Use them to answer common questions in the team's usual wording.

search_term.description: Text in the shortcut or message.

access_to.description: Restrict to quick replies shared with this audience, as defined in DoubleTick.

last_quick_reply_date.description: Cursor: date of the last quick reply of the previous page.

tools.name: doubletick_list_webhooks
tools.description: List the webhooks registered for the organisation with name, URL, subscribed events and creator. Use it to see which systems receive DoubleTick events.

tools.name: doubletick_send_text_message
tools.description: Send a free-form WhatsApp text message to a customer or a WhatsApp group. Only works within 24 hours of the customer's last message; otherwise send a template.

from.description: Your WhatsApp business number with country code, e.g. +919999999999.

to.description: Customer number with country code. Leave empty when sending to group_id.

group_id.description: WhatsApp group id, instead of to.

text.description: Message text. WhatsApp formatting (*bold*, _italic_) is supported.

message_id.description: Optional UUID v4 to use as the message id (for idempotency).

tools.name: doubletick_send_image_message
tools.description: Send an image by public URL, with an optional caption, to a customer or a WhatsApp group. Same 24-hour window rule as text messages.

from.description: Your WhatsApp business number with country code.

to.description: Customer number with country code. Leave empty when sending to group_id.

group_id.description: WhatsApp group id, instead of to.

media_url.description: Public URL of the image (JPEG or PNG).

message_id.description: Optional UUID v4 to use as the message id.

tools.name: doubletick_send_document_message
tools.description: Send a document (PDF, spreadsheet...) by public URL with an optional file name and caption, e.g. an invoice or a quote. Same 24-hour window rule as text messages.

from.description: Your WhatsApp business number with country code.

to.description: Customer number with country code. Leave empty when sending to group_id.

group_id.description: WhatsApp group id, instead of to.

filename.description: File name shown to the customer, e.g. Invoice-1042.pdf.

message_id.description: Optional UUID v4 to use as the message id.

tools.name: doubletick_send_template_message
tools.description: Send an approved WhatsApp template to a customer, also outside the 24-hour window. Body placeholders are key-value objects. Returns per-message status and messageId; charges the wallet.

from.description: Your WhatsApp business number with country code.

to.description: Customer number with country code. Leave empty when sending to group_id.

group_id.description: WhatsApp group id, instead of to.

language.description: Template language code, exactly as listed, e.g. en or en_US.

template_data.description: Values for the template: {"header": {"type": "IMAGE", "mediaUrl": "https://..."}, "body": {"placeholders": [{"name": "Asha"}, {"order": "1042"}]}, "buttons": [{"type": "URL", "parameter": "abc"}]}. Omit parts the template does not have.

custom_data.description: Optional data echoed back in DoubleTick webhooks for this message.

tools.name: doubletick_send_broadcast
tools.description: Send an approved template to every member of a broadcast group. Placeholders like {{Name}} are filled per member. Charges the wallet for each recipient; check the balance first.

from.description: Your WhatsApp business number with country code.

template_data.description: Template values: {"header": {...}, "body": {"placeholders": ["{{Name}}", "Diwali sale"]}, "buttons": [...]}. Broadcast body placeholders are plain strings.

tools.name: doubletick_update_customer_tags
tools.description: Add tags and set custom fields on a customer, and optionally its name, opt-in and assigned agent. Creates the customer if the number is new. Existing tags are kept.

phone.description: Customer phone number with country code, e.g. 919876543210.

agent_phone.description: Agent to assign, phone with country code.

waba_number.description: Your WhatsApp business number the tags belong to.

tools.name: doubletick_remove_customer_tags
tools.description: Remove tags and custom field values from a customer. Pass empty arrays for the part you do not want to change.

phone.description: Customer phone number with country code.

custom_fields.description: Names of the custom fields to clear.

waba_number.description: Your WhatsApp business number the tags belong to.

tools.name: doubletick_assign_chat
tools.description: Assign a customer chat (customer_phone_number) or a WhatsApp group chat (group_id) to a team member. Set reassign to true to move a chat that already has an agent.

customer_phone_number.description: Customer phone number with country code. Use this or group_id.

group_id.description: WhatsApp group id. Use this or customer_phone_number.

waba_number.description: Your WhatsApp business number (customer chats only).

reassign.description: true to replace the current agent.

tools.name: doubletick_create_note
tools.description: Add an internal note to a customer chat (from + to) or a WhatsApp group chat (group_id). Notes are seen by the team, never by the customer.

from.description: Your WhatsApp business number with country code.

to.description: Customer phone number with country code.

group_id.description: WhatsApp group id, instead of from and to.

entities.description: Mentions that notify team members: [{"type": "user", "id": "<user id>"}].

tools.name: doubletick_create_broadcast_group
tools.description: Create a broadcast group with an optional first list of members. Returns the group id and any numbers rejected as invalid.

name.description: Group name, used later to send broadcasts.

tools.name: doubletick_add_broadcast_group_members
tools.description: Add members to an existing broadcast group by group id. Returns the updated count and any numbers rejected as invalid.
